create_door_env: create a DoorEnvV0 instance to initialize a MuJoCo door manipulation environment with randomized door positions
run_step_simulation: run a single simulation step on the door environment with a clipped action vector and compute rewards
get_observation: get the current observation vector including hand qpos, door position, palm and handle positions
reset_door_model: reset the door environment model to initial state with randomized door body position
evaluate_success_rate: evaluate the success percentage of rollout paths where the door was opened for more than 25 steps
